evidence.citation: Artifact: "Any justified edit should address only that diagnosed defect, then be verified by re-running every case... with fresh blind agents, isolated writable sandboxes where needed, a post-run checkout sweep... Continue until all cases meet their required pass-rate bars, while checking for regressions."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact’s repeated runs, isolated sandboxes, and post-run checkout sweep are framed as verification, regression checking, and integrity controls after any justified edit. Under the supplied bar, that execution work is necessary rather than materially unnecessary.
